summary: This is a routine 6-K filing by AXIA Energia S.A. reporting the settlement of its 9th issuance of non-convertible, unsecured debentures in the amount of BRL 1 billion. The debentures are tax-incentivized, pay IPCA + 8.0036% p.a., mature in 10 years, and were offered to professional investors under automatic registration. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or restructuring is involved. The filing merely updates the market on a completed debt issuance, with no impact on equity or corporate control.
